ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) localized pixel features creating high local contrast.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density white clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered white circular rings (annular motifs) distributed across the medial and lateral regions; multiple high-contrast white linear segments visible on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated shallow V-shaped central depression with an obtuse angle of approximately 115 degrees and a vertical depth ratio of ~0.05 relative to the horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations observed along the right lobe trailing edge with multiple sharp indentations; left lobe trailing edge displays lower-frequency, rounded undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-curving convex trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in pointed, high-intensity tip regions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular white rings (5-15 pixel diameter) localized on the outer lateral margins and scattered across the central black surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct, high-contrast diagonal white line on the left lobe (approx. mid-height); multiple smaller vertical and horizontal white scratches intersecting on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the entire visible surface; right lobe tip exhibits a jagged, irregular traumatic profile compared to the left; prominent rake-like linear abrasions on both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly concentrated white calcification-like textures at the extreme lateral tips of the flukes, forming a bright 'capped' appearance against the dark primary pigmentation.
